measured_progress: Separate ICU collators on API31/37, component/dialog selectors, root Material canvas, actual large-font body and seven prior failures' non-focus boundaries now pass. Source floor and twenty-one uncredited producer families remain unchanged.

remaining_failures.storage_font200_rtl: Actual dialog fontScale2 is now asserted successfully, but layout remains LTR in the test host lacking Android supports-RTL/decor direction.
remaining_failures.region_focus: Focused native form still fails idle at resize despite manually stepping the clock; focus must wait for the attached dialog window to gain focus rather than demand it before native window ownership.
remaining_failures.pill_first_frame: First Syncing node remains absent; reactive retained-state mutation schedules another composition. Incoming state is kept direct and retention becomes a non-reactive remembered holder, without relaxing the first-frame assertion.
remaining_failures.filesystem_cleanup: The actual typed IO write failure, old bytes and reporting checks reach cleanup; DataStore itself deletes the blocked empty temporary directory. Cleanup must handle an already-removed obstacle rather than mask successful failure assertions.

repair_scope: Owned UI production/consumer tests only; proper native RTL host capability/direction, window-focused admission, no extra retained-state recomposition and targeted temporary-path cleanup. Same assertions/methods/source130158/197/21-policy count; no timeout/dependency/source/type/palette/golden/ROOT/local lock expectation change.
